easyPrerequisites: There's two or more creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing HYDRA Troopers, adding {C}{C}.
When HYDRA Troopers dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return HYDRA Troopers from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When HYDRA Troopers enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
